preconditions.description: The number of points on the mountain is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The heights are non-negative integers in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == h_i_final for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the final height after the landslide has stopped.
